protocol.name: Avi-Tag Protein Biotinylation
protocol.purpose: Biotinylate an Avi-tagged protein for downstream binding assays or immobilization.

steps.text: Prepare the biotinylation reaction by combining {{ph:1774024745003-093192d094133}} of Avi-tagged protein, {{ph:1774024745003-fbbbfbaa73e5b}} of BirA, {{ph:1774024745003-d6f73ec6557a1}} of biotin, ATP, and buffer.
Assess biotinylation efficiency using {{ph:1774024745003-0dd0ef09f4b6c}}, such as streptavidin shift or binding assay.

protocol.troubleshooting:
Problem: Incomplete biotinylation; Possible cause: Insufficient BirA activity or reaction time; Solution: Increase BirA amount, extend incubation time, or confirm buffer contains required cofactors
Problem: Poor downstream immobilization; Possible cause: Residual free biotin interferes with streptavidin binding; Solution: Thoroughly remove excess biotin after the reaction
